ContractsHero._note: <ContractsHero {...} />. Money props are INTEGER CENTS (fmtMoney). allZero = inFlightCount===0 && pendingDeposits===0 && startingSoonCount===0 → empty sub-line + hides active-value line. CTA is a static <a href=/assistant?seed=…>.

ContractsKpis._note: <ContractsKpis {...} />. 4 cards: In progress (accent/pink), Starting soon, Wrapping up, Closed this month. All *Value/*Left props are INTEGER CENTS.

ScheduleStrip._note: <ScheduleStrip cards={ContractCard[]} />. Lays out live cards by scheduleStart/scheduleEnd (day-of-window coords, day 8 = today). packLanes() greedily stacks overlapping bars into lanes; bars outside 1..30 are filtered. scheduleScheduled=true → dashed bar.
